prompt: The Brihadeeswarar Temple was built by an Indian emperor. The emperor’s only sister‘s husband is a king of another Dynasty. Name the Dynasty and state how many known kings ruled within that Dynasty.
answer:
The emperor was **Rajaraja Chola I**, builder of the Brihadeeswarar Temple. His elder sister **Kundavai** married **Vimaladitya**, a king of the **Eastern Chalukya dynasty**, also known as the **Chalukyas of Vengi**.

The standard list counts **29 known rulers** of the Eastern Chalukya dynasty, though some sources vary slightly depending on whether short-lived or transitional rulers are included.
